cues: What makes them take up water?
When blue light falls on the leaf, receptors called phototropins switch on a proton pump in the guard-cell membrane.
Protons are pumped out, and the inside of the cell becomes strongly negative.
text: What makes them take up water? Potassium. When blue light falls on the leaf, receptors called phototropins switch on a proton pump in the guard-cell membrane. Protons are pumped out, and the inside of the cell becomes strongly negative.
